title: Beautify our Spa/Laundry common area
description:
Help us transform our Spa/Laundry common area into a calm, beautiful space the whole house loves to use. Through design, art, plants, lighting, and smart organization, you’ll turn a purely functional corner into a place that feels like a true retreat. Artists, designers, makers, and anyone with an eye for space are welcome to apply.

You’ll deliver: a quick design concept, regular check-ins with housemates, and a finished transformation with before-and-after photos.

We offer: accomodation, a materials budget, on-site tools, and a supportive community.
externalFormInstructions: Your external application form must include the Pilgrim wallet address and/or the pseudonym displayed on Hubs Network, so that the Hub can match the form response to the on-chain Passport application.
